purpose: Complete the new-seed DeepSea comparison with the same seven baseline families used in KeyCorridor.
selection: Per-size baseline recipes copied from original development selection; PDR_SAC_A1_B32 frozen in prior WINNERS.json. No tuning on these validation seeds.
cohort: Exactly the 52 eligible predeclared new starts of the completed CQL/PDR validation (20/19/13). All eight originally unavailable starts retained in the record; no replacements.
metric: Expected return; normalized trapezoidal mean over the complete early window.
comparison: Algorithm comparison from common starts, support, replay pools, actor-batch schedules and actor-update budget. Methods retain their own losses; PER resamples critic batches, 8xTD has eight critic updates, PS uses its selected planning budget.
backbones: TD/PER/DisCor/8xTD/PS retain their archived AWAC actor; IQL retains its own actor loss; CQL and selected PDR use SAC. PDR shares the CQL critic update rule and uses an exact soft reference. This is not a same-actor-objective ablation.
preparation: Reuse original bootstrapped-DQN/LOW-band/distillation input artifacts; do not regenerate starts.
checkpoints: Complete initial/final models, targets, optimizers, RNG, replay/planning state; interrupted runs retain resumable progress.

execution.resource_policy: Wait for GPUs without foreign compute processes and at least 20 GiB free. Do not stop or modify other jobs.
